about: The Preface used in the season of the formulary “Ascension of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.nr: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

seg.tr: It is truly meet and just, right and profitable for our salvation, that we should at all times and in all places give thanks unto Thee, O holy Lord, Father almighty, everlasting God, through Christ our Lord. Who after His Resurrection appeared openly to all His disciples and, while they beheld Him, was raised up into heaven, that He might grant us to be partakers of His divinity. And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominations, and with all the host of the heavenly army, we sing a hymn to Thy glory, evermore saying:
g: sift, separate, distinguish, discern, resolve, determine
